summary.text: The Department of Labor has adopted a comprehensive strategy to ensure AI is implemented responsibly, effectively, and ethically, aiming to enhance operations and customer service (s15, s16). The DOL CAIO office manages AI use cases, requiring tools to pass a security review and be added to an authorized list before deployment (s4, s7). DOL is drafting updated contract language and intends to integrate responsible AI language into all IT contracts and Interagency Agreements (s3, s5). DOL has advocated against using publicly available GenAI tools due to the risk they present in exposing DOL information or training the models on DOL information (s13).
